# Introduction

Gulls are passive creatures. They are small birds with long legs and heavy, straight bills. These birds are mainly white, with a yellow beak, gray wings and pinkish beige legs and feet.

### Drops

• Item: Feathers | 0 Star: 3

## Notes

• Loose-rolling tree logs will roll right through them without damaging them whatsoever.

Categorias: Passive creatures
